    /* Prologue */
    addi    sp, sp, -64
    sd      ra, 56(sp)
    sd      s0, 48(sp)
    sd      s1, 40(sp)
    sd      s2, 32(sp)
    sd      s3, 24(sp)
    sd      s4, 16(sp)
    sd      s5, 8(sp)

    mv      s1, a1              /* synth_buf_ptr */
    mv      s2, a2              /* synth_buf_offset* */
    mv      s3, a3              /* synth_buf2 */
    mv      s4, a4              /* window */
    mv      s5, a5              /* out */
    mv      s6, a9              /* imdct_fn */

    lw      t0, 0(s2)           /* offset */
    slli    t1, t0, 2
    add     t2, s1, t1          /* t2 = synth_buf */

    /* Call imdct_fn(imdct, synth_buf, in, sizeof(float)) */

    mv      a1, t2
    mv      a2, a6              /* in */
    li      a3, 4               /* sizeof(float) */

    /* for i=0..15 */

1:

    flw     ft1, 0(t5)          /* a */

    slli    t6, t6, 2
    add     t6, s3, t6
    flw     ft2, 0(t6)          /* b */
